ticket.title: Bill Discount Management with Audit Trail
ticket.text:
Bill Discount Management with Audit Trail

Enable administrators to apply discounts to patient bills with full traceability. All discounts must capture initiator, approver, amount, justification, and timestamp for complete auditability.

User Story:

- As an Administrator, I want a feature to apply discounts to patient bills, so that we can support facility-level financial needs while maintaining full auditability and preventing informal practices.

Functional Requirements:

- Access Control and Configuration
  - The ability to initiate or approve discounts is restricted to Admin roles only
  - Discount functionality must be configurable (enabled/disabled) at the facility level
  - Facilities can enable/disable the discount feature through system settings
  - When disabled, discount options are hidden from all users, including admins
  - Cannot apply multiple discounts to the same bill
  - Cannot apply discount to bills with status: PAID, REFUNDED, CANCELLED
- Discount Initiation
  - Administrators can apply discounts to bills with a status of PENDING or UNPAID
  - Discount can be applied as:
    - Percentage discount (e.g., 10%, 25%, 50%)
    - Fixed amount discount (e.g., 500, 1,000)
  - System validates that the discount does not exceed the bill total
  - Add "Apply Discount" action button on eligible bills
- Every Discount Captures the following Information
  - Initiator ID: Admin user who initiated the discount
  - Approver ID: Admin user who approved the discount (if different from initiator)
  - Discount value: The percentage or specific amount
  - Justification: Mandatory reason for discount
  - Date and time stamp: Automatic capture of when the discount was applied
- Invoice and Receipt Display
  - Original price: Full amount before discount e.g., 5,000
  - Discount applied: Amount, e.g., 500
  - Final amount: Amount due after discount e.g., 4,500
- Audit Trail
  - Bill reference number
  - Patient name and identifier
  - Original amount
  - Discount amount
  - Final amount
  - Initiator name and ID
  - Approver name and ID (where applicable)
  - Justification reason
  - Timestamp

understanding.intent: Enable administrators to configure and apply traceable percentage or fixed discounts with mandatory justifications to eligible patient bills, reflecting the changes on invoices, receipts, and an audit trail.

questions: Is there a multi-step approval workflow required (e.g., pending approval queue), or does a single administrator initiate and apply the discount directly?
Where should the discount audit trail be displayed in the UI (e.g., on the bill details page, or in a separate audit report)?
